Equiknoxx is a collective of Jamaican producers and vocalists, known for their uniquely futurist take on Jamaican Dancehall.   

The project started in 2005 as Equiknoxx Music (a.k.a. Equiknoxx Musiq) being a label that was primarily producing for other vocalists. Shanique Marie and Kemikal were two of those vocalists, with Gavsborg  (real name: Gavin Blair) and Bobby Blackbird (real name: Nicholas Deane) doing the production. Around 2009 Gavsborg met producer Time Cow  (real name: Jordan Chung)
